PortRanges.description: The port ranges the resource configuration listens on, as single ports or ranges (for example, 80 or 1001-2000). Applies to SINGLE, GROUP, CHILD, and CIDR resource configurations. For a CIDR resource configuration with ProtocolType TCP_UDP, these ranges cover both TCP and UDP traffic, so include port 53 to carry DNS to the network segment.
